sentences.text: On Kiln-Py, Gimlet-L achieved a lower failure rate (34.0%) than Ostler (38.8%), a 4.8-percentage-point improvement.
On the repository-level Kiln-PyX benchmark, Gimlet-L also outperformed Ostler, with failure rates of 68.9% versus 76.5%, respectively.

These results indicate that Gimlet-L, a 13B-parameter model fine-tuned with execution feedback, consistently reduced failure rates relative to the similarly sized Ostler baseline on both benchmarks, although no statistical tests were reported.
